requirements.section: 14. Evidence Bundle References / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants

Directly tested by test_cm_ebref_002_valid_evidence_bundle_reference_creation, test_cm_ebref_002_reference_carries_correct_bundle_id, test_cm_ebref_002_reference_carries_correct_schema_version, test_cm_ebref_002_missing_bundle_id_rejected, and test_cm_ebref_002_missing_schema_version_rejected.

requirements.section: 14. Evidence Bundle References / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants
requirements.requirement_text: Supplementary Evidence Bundle References MUST be distinguishable from the primary reference.
requirements.rationale: Wave B (PR #64): build_cm001_manifest's _validate_distinguishable rejects, before any write, a supplementary Evidence Bundle Reference sharing the primary reference's bundle_id, and rejects duplicate supplementary references. Directly tested by test_cm_ebref_003_supplementary_reference_distinguishable_from_primary, test_cm_ebref_003_indistinguishable_supplementary_reference_rejected, and test_cm_ebref_003_duplicate_supplementary_references_rejected.

requirements.section: 14. Evidence Bundle References / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants

requirements.requirement_text: Hash References MUST be independently recomputable and verifiable by a validator.
requirements.rationale: Wave A (PR #63): verify_hash_reference independently recomputes the digest of supplied data and compares it to the declared value -- it never trusts a prior verification result. requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST NOT apply to more than one Certification Subject.
requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.requirement_text: The Certification Subject identified by a Technical Certificate MUST match the Certification Subject identified by the Certification Manifest it references.
requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.requirement_text: A mismatch MUST cause verification to fail under Section 15.
requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST NOT record a certification result of FAIL. No Certificate model exists for a FAIL outcome, since Certificates are never issued for a FAIL certification result.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.requirement_text: The certification result recorded by a Technical Certificate MUST match the certification result recorded by the Certification Manifest it references.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.requirement_text: A mismatch MUST cause verification to fail under Section 15.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.section: 9. Certification Result Representation / 9.4 Certified Capability Profiles
requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST record the capability profiles verified during certification, consistent with MCC-CP-001, Section 11.6.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.section: 9. Certification Result Representation / 9.4 Certified Capability Profiles
requirements.requirement_text: A capability profile MUST NOT appear as certified on a Technical Certificate unless it was verified during the certification the Certificate attests to.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate SHALL remain framework-neutral and implementation-independent, and SHALL be independently verifiable by a party holding only the Certificate, a recognized Trust Anchor, and this specification.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: It is not, and SHALL NOT be interpreted as, a runtime execution authorization.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: The key words MUST, MUST NOT, REQUIRED, SHALL, SHALL NOT, SHOULD, SHOULD NOT, RECOMMENDED, MAY and OPTIONAL in this specification are to be interpreted as described in RFC 2119 and RFC 8174.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: Compatibility claims between Certificate Schema Versions MUST be explicit, not assumed.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TC001_CERT_SCHEMA_VERSION is an explicit, single-valued constant -- no forward-compatibility is assumed for any other value. Directly tested by test_tc_compat_001_schema_version_compatibility_is_explicit.

requirements.requirement_text: Unrecognized Certificate Schema Versions MUST NOT be silently accepted.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate returns UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA, never VALID, for an unrecognized certificate_schema_version. Directly tested by test_tc_compat_002_unrecognized_schema_version_not_silently_accepted.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate validity MUST account for the compatibility of any referenced Manifest Schema Version.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): manifest_reference_verification reuses verify_cm001_manifest, which itself rejects an unrecognized manifest_schema_version. Directly tested by test_tc_compat_003_validity_accounts_for_manifest_schema_version_compatibility.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate validity MUST account for the compatibility of the Evidence Bundle Schema Version identified by the direct Evidence Bundle Reference.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): evidence_bundle_reference_consistency reuses verify_evidence_bundle_reference / verify_eb001_bundle, which reject an unrecognized Evidence Bundle schema_version. Directly tested by test_tc_compat_004_validity_accounts_for_evidence_bundle_schema_version_compatibility.

requirements.requirement_text: Conformance is defined separately for Certificate issuers and Certificate verifiers.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): issuer-side (build/sign) and verifier-side (verify) are distinct functions with distinct fail-closed contracts. Directly tested by test_tc_conf_001_conformance_defined_separately_for_issuer_and_verifier.

requirements.requirement_text: A conforming issuer MUST NOT issue Certificates for a non-PASS result.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): build_technical_certificate's signature has no certification_result parameter -- a non-PASS Certificate cannot be constructed. Directly tested by test_tc_conf_002_issuer_never_issues_for_a_non_pass_result.

requirements.requirement_text: A conforming verifier MUST implement fail-closed verification in full, including revocation checking.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate implements every Section 15 step in order, including the Revocation Check. Directly tested by test_tc_conf_003_verifier_implements_fail_closed_verification_including_revocation.

requirements.requirement_text: Conformance MUST remain framework-neutral and implementation-independent.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): tc001_certificate.py has no framework-specific dependency (langgraph/autogen/crewai/voltagent/web framework). Directly tested by test_tc_conf_004_conformance_is_framework_neutral.

requirements.requirement_text: A conforming issuer MUST ensure its direct Evidence Bundle Reference and its Certification Manifest's Evidence Bundle Reference identify the same Evidence Bundle before issuance.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): build_technical_certificate refuses to issue when its direct Evidence Bundle Reference and the Manifest's primary reference disagree, checked before signing. Directly tested by test_tc_conf_005_issuer_ensures_reference_consistency_before_issuance and test_scenario_09_producer_refuses_mismatched_direct_and_manifest_bundle_references.

requirements.requirement_text: Extensions MUST be explicitly declared within the Certificate.
requirements.rationale: No extension-declaration mechanism (a way to mark additional fields as explicit, non-breaking extensions to a committed schema) was found anywhere in this repository for any artifact.

requirements.requirement_text: Extensions MUST NOT redefine the meaning of Required Fields, the Signature, the Manifest Reference, or the Evidence Bundle Reference.
requirements.rationale: No extension-declaration mechanism (a way to mark additional fields as explicit, non-breaking extensions to a committed schema) was found anywhere in this repository for any artifact.

requirements.requirement_text: Extension content MUST be covered by the Certificate's Signature.
requirements.rationale: No extension-declaration mechanism (a way to mark additional fields as explicit, non-breaking extensions to a committed schema) was found anywhere in this repository for any artifact.

requirements.requirement_text: Unrecognized extensions MUST be ignored, not treated as verification failures.
requirements.rationale: No extension-declaration mechanism (a way to mark additional fields as explicit, non-breaking extensions to a committed schema) was found anywhere in this repository for any artifact.

requirements.requirement_text: A Hash Reference to the Certification Manifest or to the Evidence Bundle MUST use a collision-resistant hash algorithm.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): both Manifest Reference and Evidence Bundle Reference Hash References use algorithm="sha256", reusing hash_reference.py's closed, collision-resistant algorithm set unchanged. Directly tested by test_tc_hash_001_manifest_and_bundle_hash_references_use_sha256.

requirements.requirement_text: Manifest and Evidence Bundle binding MUST each be independently recomputable and verifiable.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate independently recomputes both bindings (manifest_reference_verification, evidence_bundle_reference_consistency) rather than trusting a stored flag. Directly tested by test_tc_hash_002_bindings_are_independently_recomputable.

requirements.requirement_text: Whole-Certificate integrity MUST be provided by its Signature, not by a separate mechanism.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): the Certificate schema has no separate self-digest field -- whole-Certificate integrity is provided only by the Signature. Directly tested by test_tc_hash_003_whole_certificate_integrity_via_signature_not_a_self_digest.

requirements.requirement_text: Every Technical Certificate MUST have a globally unique certificate identifier.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): every Certificate carries a required, non-empty certificate_id. Directly tested by test_tc_id_001_certificate_has_a_unique_identifier. Global uniqueness across independent Issuers is a documented, out-of-scope deployment concern (see CertificateIdRegistry's docstring).

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate identifiers MUST NOT be reused, including after revocation.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): CertificateIdRegistry.reserve fails closed on a reused certificate_id. Directly tested by test_tc_id_002_identifier_reuse_is_rejected_including_after_revocation and test_scenario_19_reused_certificate_id_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: A revalidation MUST produce a new Technical Certificate with a new certificate identifier.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): a revalidation is built as a distinct Certificate with a new certificate_id (optionally declaring superseded_certificate_ids); there is no in-place re-issuance entrypoint. Directly tested by test_tc_id_003_revalidation_produces_a_new_certificate_with_a_new_id.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST identify its Issuer.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): issuer_id is a required field on every Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_iss_001_certificate_identifies_its_issuer.

requirements.requirement_text: The Issuer identifier MUST be associated with a resolvable Trust Anchor.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TrustAnchorRegistry.resolve maps the signing kid to a TrustAnchor carrying an issuer_id. Directly tested by test_tc_iss_002_issuer_identifier_associated_with_resolvable_trust_anchor.

requirements.requirement_text: An unrecognized Issuer MUST cause verification to fail.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate rejects a Certificate whose kid does not resolve in the supplied TrustAnchorRegistry. Directly tested by test_tc_iss_003_unrecognized_issuer_causes_verification_failure and test_scenario_12_unknown_signing_kid_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST represent exactly one successful (PASS) certification outcome.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): build_technical_certificate has no certification_result parameter at all -- CertificationResult has only a PASS member, so a FAIL Certificate cannot be constructed. Directly tested by test_tc_model_001_certificate_represents_exactly_one_pass_outcome and test_tc_conf_002_issuer_never_issues_for_a_non_pass_result.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST reference exactly one Certification Manifest.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TechnicalCertificate.manifest_reference is a single required field, not a collection. Directly tested by test_tc_model_002_certificate_references_exactly_one_manifest.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST NOT be interpreted or used as a runtime execution authorization.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): tc001_certificate.py imports nothing from mcc_core.gate / mcc_core.authority / gateway, and the Certificate schema has no verdict/decision field -- only certification_result (PASS-only). Directly tested by test_tc_model_003_certificate_is_not_a_runtime_execution_authorization and test_tc_sec_005_valid_certificate_not_treated_as_runtime_execution_authorization.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST remain traceable to the Certification Subject, specification version, Certification Manifest, and Evidence Bundle, by direct reference in every case.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): every issued Certificate carries subject_id, cp001_specification_version, manifest_reference, and evidence_bundle_reference as direct fields. Directly tested by test_tc_model_004_certificate_traceable_to_subject_spec_manifest_bundle.

requirements.requirement_text: Optional Fields MAY be omitted without affecting Certificate validity.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): label, expiration_timestamp, and superseded_certificate_ids are all optional and a Certificate omitting them still verifies VALID. Directly tested by test_tc_optf_001_optional_fields_may_be_omitted.

requirements.requirement_text: Optional Fields, where present, MUST conform to defined type rules.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): from_dict enforces the declared type for every present optional field. Directly tested by test_tc_optf_002_optional_fields_conform_to_type_rules_when_present.

requirements.requirement_text: Optional Fields MUST NOT substitute for Required Fields.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): populating every optional field never substitutes for a missing Required Field -- structural verification still independently requires each one. Directly tested by test_tc_optf_003_optional_fields_do_not_satisfy_required_field_obligations.

requirements.section: 9. Certification Result Representation / 9.5 Certification Result Representation Invariants
requirements.requirement_text: The certification result field MUST be present and MUST be PASS.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): certification_result is required and from_dict rejects any value other than "PASS". Directly tested by test_tc_res_001_result_field_present_and_pass, test_tc_res_001_negative_result_field_rejects_non_pass, and test_scenario_03_non_pass_result_rejected. TC-RES-002 (Manifest-side result cross-check) is explicitly excluded -- see the Wave C scope manifest.

requirements.section: 9. Certification Result Representation / 9.5 Certification Result Representation Invariants
requirements.requirement_text: The Certificate's result MUST match its referenced Manifest's result.
requirements.rationale: status=CERTIFIED is issued only for a fully-passing compliance run (fail-closed: every mandatory vector must pass, per reporting.py), the same PASS-only issuance model this section requires, though the verdict vocabulary (CERTIFIED vs. PASS) differs.

requirements.section: 9. Certification Result Representation / 9.5 Certification Result Representation Invariants
requirements.requirement_text: Certified capability profiles MUST be limited to those actually verified.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): certified_capability_profiles records exactly the caller-supplied profiles -- the producer never adds an unverified profile. Directly tested by test_tc_res_003_certified_profiles_limited_to_those_verified.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST NOT be mutated to represent revocation.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): revoke_certificate never mutates the Certificate object; its to_dict() is byte-identical before and after revocation. Directly tested by test_tc_rev_001_certificate_content_never_mutated_to_represent_revocation.

requirements.requirement_text: Revocation MUST be represented by an external Revocation Record.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): revocation is represented exclusively by an external RevocationRecord in a RevocationRegistry, never by editing the Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_rev_002_revocation_represented_by_an_external_record.

requirements.requirement_text: A Revocation Record MUST identify the certificate identifier, revocation timestamp, and authorizing Issuer.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): RevocationRecord requires certificate_id, revoked_at, and issuer_id (reason optional). Directly tested by test_tc_rev_003_revocation_record_identifies_required_fields.

requirements.requirement_text: Only the Issuer, or its designated authority under the Trust Model, MUST be able to produce a valid Revocation Record.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): RevocationRegistry.revoke refuses a record whose issuer_id does not match the authorizing TrustAnchor's issuer_id. Directly tested by test_tc_rev_004_only_the_issuer_may_produce_a_valid_revocation and test_scenario_21_revoke_with_mismatched_issuer_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: A verifier MUST check for revocation before treating a Certificate as valid.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate always checks the RevocationRegistry before returning VALID. Directly tested by test_tc_rev_005_verifier_checks_revocation_before_treating_as_valid and test_scenario_18_revoked_certificate_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: Revoked Certificates MUST remain available for audit and traceability.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): RevocationRegistry.get/is_revoked are plain, non-destructive lookups, and a revoked Certificate remains fully parseable. Directly tested by test_tc_rev_006_revoked_certificates_remain_available_for_audit.

requirements.requirement_text: All fields listed in Section 6.2 MUST be present.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): all Section 6.2 baseline fields are present on every issued Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_001_baseline_required_fields_present.

requirements.requirement_text: Issuer identity, Validity Period fields, and a Signature MUST be present.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): issuer_id, issuance_timestamp, and a Signature (kid+sig) are always present on a signed Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_002_issuer_validity_and_signature_present.

requirements.requirement_text: A Certificate omitting any Required Field MUST be rejected.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TechnicalCertificate.from_dict raises TC001StructuralError on any missing Required Field. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_003_certificate_omitting_a_required_field_is_rejected and test_scenario_01_missing_required_field_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: The Manifest Reference MUST include the Manifest identifier, the Manifest Schema Version, and a Hash Reference to the Certification Manifest.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): ManifestReference carries manifest_id, manifest_schema_version, and a Hash Reference. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_004_manifest_reference_structure.

requirements.requirement_text: The Evidence Bundle Reference MUST include the Evidence Bundle identifier, the Evidence Bundle Schema Version, and a Hash Reference to the Evidence Bundle.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): CertEvidenceBundleReference carries bundle_id, schema_version, and a Hash Reference. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_005_evidence_bundle_reference_structure.

requirements.requirement_text: The Evidence Bundle Reference MUST be direct Certificate content and MUST NOT be satisfied only by transitive resolution through the Certification Manifest.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): evidence_bundle_reference is a direct top-level Certificate field, never resolved only through manifest_reference. Directly tested by test_tc_rfld_006_evidence_bundle_reference_is_direct_not_transitive_only.

requirements.requirement_text: All identifiers defined by this specification MUST use the `TC-` namespace prefix.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: Identifiers within the `TC-` namespace MUST be globally unique.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: Retired identifiers MUST NOT be reassigned to a different requirement.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: New category tags MUST NOT collide with prefixes already registered by another MCC specification.
requirements.rationale: Interpretive, bibliographic, non-normative-by-design (explicitly marked informative/example), or document-self-referential statement. It does not describe a discrete, independently implementable system behavior.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST be a single structured, machine-readable document.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): write_tc001_certificate writes exactly one JSON document; read_tc001_certificate parses it back. Directly tested by test_tc_schema_001_certificate_is_a_single_structured_document.

requirements.requirement_text: Every Certificate field MUST have an unambiguous, defined type.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TechnicalCertificate.from_dict enforces an explicit type for every field (str/int/list/dict), rejecting ambiguous or wrong-typed values. Directly tested by test_tc_schema_002_every_field_has_an_unambiguous_type and test_tc_optf_002_optional_fields_conform_to_type_rules_when_present.

requirements.requirement_text: The top-level field groups defined in Section 4.2 MUST all be present, except where explicitly marked optional.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): every top-level field group from Section 4.2 is present on a signed Certificate except the correctly-absent optional ones. Directly tested by test_tc_schema_003_top_level_groups_all_present_except_optional.

requirements.requirement_text: Signature computation MUST use a deterministic Canonical Form that excludes the Signature field.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TechnicalCertificate.unsigned_dict() is the exact Canonical Form input to signing and excludes kid/sig. Directly tested by test_tc_schema_004_signing_canonical_form_excludes_signature_field.

requirements.requirement_text: The Certificate Schema MUST remain independent of any specific serialization technology.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): to_dict()/from_dict() round-trip independent of any file writer or transport. Directly tested by test_tc_schema_005_schema_independent_of_serialization_technology.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate verification MUST assume an untrusted source.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): a fully forged Certificate dict (fabricated fields, invalid signature) is rejected -- verification never assumes good faith from the source. Directly tested by test_tc_sec_001_verification_assumes_untrusted_source.

requirements.requirement_text: Forgery and tamper detection MUST rely on Signature Verification against a recognized Trust Anchor.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): forgery/tamper detection is provided exclusively by Ed25519 signature verification against a recognized Trust Anchor. Directly tested by test_tc_sec_002_forgery_resistance_via_signature_only.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificates MUST NOT contain secrets or credentials.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): the closed field set (_ALL_ALLOWED_FIELDS) has no secret/credential-shaped field, and any undeclared field is rejected at parse time. Directly tested by test_tc_sec_003_certificate_contains_no_secrets_or_credentials and test_scenario_02_undeclared_extra_field_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: Sensitive underlying data MUST be redacted or hashed before inclusion in a Certificate field.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): the Manifest and Evidence Bundle are referenced exclusively by Hash Reference (digest/algorithm/content_ref) -- their raw content is never embedded in the Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_sec_004_sensitive_data_referenced_only_via_hash_reference.

requirements.requirement_text: A valid Technical Certificate MUST NOT be treated as a runtime execution authorization.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): tc001_certificate.py imports no gate/authority/coordinator/egress internals -- a valid Certificate has no code path into runtime execution. Directly tested by test_tc_sec_005_valid_certificate_not_treated_as_runtime_execution_authorization.

requirements.requirement_text: Every Technical Certificate MUST be signed using an asymmetric digital signature scheme.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): sign_technical_certificate signs exclusively via mcc_core.signing.SigningKey (Ed25519, asymmetric). Directly tested by test_tc_sig_001_certificate_signed_with_asymmetric_scheme.

requirements.requirement_text: HMAC and other symmetric-key authentication mechanisms MUST NOT be used to sign a Technical Certificate.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): tc001_certificate.py imports no symmetric-key/shared-secret signing module -- Ed25519 via mcc_core.signing is the only signing path. Directly tested by test_tc_sig_002_symmetric_key_mechanisms_never_used.

requirements.requirement_text: A Signature MUST cover the complete Canonical Form of the Certificate excluding the Signature field.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): the signature covers unsigned_dict() (the complete Canonical Form excluding kid/sig); modifying any covered field invalidates verification. Directly tested by test_tc_sig_003_signature_covers_complete_canonical_form_excluding_itself.

requirements.requirement_text: A Certificate MUST declare its signature algorithm and Issuer identity.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): every Certificate declares signature_algorithm ("Ed25519") and issuer_id alongside the signing kid. Directly tested by test_tc_sig_004_certificate_declares_algorithm_and_issuer_identity.

requirements.requirement_text: Modification of any signed field MUST invalidate the Signature.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): modifying certificate_id, issuance_timestamp, or certified_capability_profiles post-signing each independently invalidates the signature. Directly tested by test_tc_sig_005_modification_of_any_signed_field_invalidates_signature and test_scenario_13_forged_signature_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: A Technical Certificate MUST identify exactly one Certification Subject.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): subject_id is a single required non-empty string field -- a Certificate cannot declare more than one Subject. Directly tested by test_tc_subj_001_certificate_identifies_exactly_one_subject. TC-SUBJ-002/003 (Manifest-side Subject cross-check) are explicitly excluded -- see the Wave C scope manifest.

requirements.requirement_text: The Certificate's Subject MUST match its referenced Manifest's Subject.
requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.requirement_text: A Subject mismatch MUST cause verification failure.
requirements.rationale: adapter_key / implementation_id in certifications/manifest.json identify exactly one subject per record, the same one-subject-per-record model this section requires.

requirements.requirement_text: A verifier MUST rely only on Trust Anchors it recognizes.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TrustAnchorRegistry.resolve returns None for any kid outside its own recognized set -- an empty registry trusts nothing. Directly tested by test_tc_trust_001_verifier_relies_only_on_recognized_trust_anchors.

requirements.requirement_text: Trust MUST NOT be inferred from a Certificate's self-declared Issuer identity alone.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verification cross-checks the resolved TrustAnchor's issuer_id against the Certificate's declared issuer_id -- a self-declared issuer_id is never trusted on its own (and is itself covered by the Signature, so changing it without re-signing invalidates verification). Directly tested by test_tc_trust_002_trust_not_inferred_from_self_declared_issuer_alone and test_scenario_14_issuer_id_mismatch_with_trust_anchor_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: Trust Anchor rotation or revocation MUST NOT retroactively invalidate the historical record of issuance.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TrustAnchorRegistry.revoke_key stops future resolution of a kid without altering any previously-issued Certificate's content. Directly tested by test_tc_trust_003_rotation_does_not_retroactively_invalidate_historical_issuance and test_scenario_15_revoked_trust_anchor_key_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: A verifier MAY recognize multiple Trust Anchors across multiple Issuers.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TrustAnchorRegistry holds multiple Trust Anchors across multiple issuer_ids simultaneously. Directly tested by test_tc_trust_004_verifier_may_recognize_multiple_trust_anchors.

requirements.requirement_text: Every Technical Certificate MUST record an issuance timestamp.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): issuance_timestamp is a required integer field on every Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_valid_001_issuance_timestamp_recorded.

requirements.requirement_text: A Certificate MUST NOT be valid before its issuance timestamp.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate's validity_period check rejects ``now < issuance_timestamp``. Directly tested by test_tc_valid_002_not_valid_before_issuance and test_scenario_17_not_yet_valid_certificate_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: An expired Certificate, where an expiration timestamp is declared and passed, MUST NOT be treated as valid.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): the validity_period check rejects ``now > expiration_timestamp`` when declared. Directly tested by test_tc_valid_003_expired_certificate_not_treated_as_valid and test_scenario_16_expired_certificate_rejected.

requirements.requirement_text: Absence of an expiration timestamp MUST NOT be treated as a validation failure.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): a Certificate with no expiration_timestamp remains valid indefinitely (absent revocation). Directly tested by test_tc_valid_004_absence_of_expiration_is_not_a_failure.

requirements.requirement_text: Verification MUST be fail-closed.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): verify_technical_certificate never returns a partial-pass status -- only VALID, INVALID, or UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_001_verification_is_fail_closed.

requirements.requirement_text: Structural verification MUST precede signature, manifest reference, evidence bundle reference, and consistency verification.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): structural verification runs first and a structurally-invalid Certificate never reaches signature verification. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_002_structural_verification_precedes_everything_else.

requirements.requirement_text: Signature verification MUST use a Trust Anchor associated with the declared Issuer.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): signature verification resolves the signing kid through the supplied TrustAnchorRegistry, never trusting an unresolved key. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_003_signature_verified_against_a_trust_anchor.

requirements.requirement_text: Validity and revocation MUST both be checked, independent of all other verification steps.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): validity_period and revocation_check are each independently evaluated and recorded as distinct checks. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_004_validity_and_revocation_both_checked.

requirements.requirement_text: A Certificate failing any verification step MUST be rejected in its entirety.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): any single failing check (e.g. an invalid signature) yields overall_status=INVALID for the whole Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_005_any_failing_step_rejects_the_whole_certificate.

requirements.requirement_text: A verifier MUST reject a Technical Certificate whose direct Evidence Bundle Reference identifies a different Evidence Bundle than the Evidence Bundle Reference contained in its referenced Certification Manifest.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): evidence_bundle_reference_consistency explicitly rejects a Certificate whose direct Evidence Bundle Reference identifies a different Bundle than the referenced Manifest's own primary reference. Directly tested by test_tc_verify_006_mismatched_direct_and_manifest_evidence_bundle_references_rejected and test_scenario_10_verifier_rejects_mismatched_direct_and_manifest_bundle_references.

requirements.requirement_text: Every Technical Certificate MUST declare a Certificate Schema Version.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): certificate_schema_version is a required Identity field on every Certificate. Directly tested by test_tc_vsn_001_certificate_declares_a_schema_version.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate Schema Versions MUST be immutable once published.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): TC001_CERT_SCHEMA_VERSION is a fixed module-level constant, never computed or mutated at runtime. Directly tested by test_tc_vsn_002_schema_version_constant_is_immutable_string.

requirements.requirement_text: Certificate Schema Version MUST be tracked independently of MCC-CP-001, MCC-EB-001, and MCC-CM-001 versions.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): certificate_schema_version, cp001_specification_version, manifest_schema_version, and Evidence Bundle schema_version are four distinct fields, never conflated. Directly tested by test_tc_vsn_003_schema_version_tracked_independently_of_other_specs.

requirements.requirement_text: An unrecognized Certificate Schema Version MUST cause verification to fail.
requirements.rationale: Wave C (PR #65): an unrecognized certificate_schema_version causes verify_technical_certificate to return UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA, never VALID. Directly tested by test_tc_vsn_004_unrecognized_schema_version_causes_verification_failure and test_scenario_04_unrecognized_schema_version_yields_unsupported_schema.
